purpose: Measure client-observed transport and output arrival for the reviewed live request without a simulator, action execution or retrospective attribution to the earlier flight.

provider.payload_change: Only stream false becomes true. Canonical JSON is reserialized; the streaming wire bytes and SHA differ from the original. All messages, response format, model and token settings are unchanged.

receive_limits.note: SSE framing is additional transport overhead; this cap is not byte-equivalent to the prior non-streaming response cap. No reasoning/answer token budget is enlarged.

timing.origin: monotonic time immediately before network connection
timing.deadline: One absolute deadline includes connection, headers and the entire receive interval. Role-only chunks, comments and heartbeat traffic never extend it.
timing.completion: After finish_reason stop and DONE, validate the assembled answer and close the client connection without waiting for HTTP EOF. Record actual EOF only if observed and client close separately; delayed server closure cannot invalidate an otherwise complete answer.
timing.interpretation: These are client-observed arrivals. They do not measure provider queue time, internal inference start or server compute duration. Missing fields remain null.

valid_response: HTTP 200 and correctly framed SSE from the fixed endpoint
Every returned model matches the requested canonical model
A complete final answer with finish_reason stop and DONE, not partial JSON or reasoning alone
Strict JSON, eligible action, summary length 1..600 and 1..16 unique reference IDs present in this exact request
No tool call or echoed credential in answer; saved evidence contains no raw reasoning, answer text or credential
result_rule_application: Apply the first two entries as per-replicate execution rules. After the cohort ends, independently apply the remaining ordered aggregate interpretations and always report every attempted and missing replicate, including failures alongside any slow valid response.

result_actions_ordered.when: source/input hash drift, credential failure, HTTP 4xx or resource/cohort budget failure
result_actions_ordered.next: Stop the cohort, preserve already attempted replicates and do not replace missing replicates.

result_actions_ordered.when: a replicate times out, has malformed output, lacks an answer, or fails validation without a cohort stop condition
result_actions_ordered.next: Retain it as a failure and run only the remaining preregistered replicate numbers within the original cohort budget. This is fixed repeated measurement, never a success-until-retry.

result_actions_ordered.when: all three valid responses complete within 120 seconds
result_actions_ordered.next: The earlier timeout was not reproduced in this three-sample streaming cohort. Do not infer reliability, causality or retrospectively count an AI flight decision. Prepare a separate next-flight plan before execution.

result_actions_ordered.when: one or more valid responses complete after 120 seconds but within 300 seconds
result_actions_ordered.next: Observed completion exceeds the prior transport cap. Propose a separately registered flight budget only if prediction plus model plus guard plus IPC fits the 598-second planning limit, or separately register Jev-first routing. Do not change production settings here.

result_actions_ordered.when: reasoning deltas arrive but no complete valid answer, or finish reason is length
result_actions_ordered.next: Record generation/output-budget symptoms without claiming a root cause; inspect the offline interface and prepare any parameter change as a new registration, not an extra run.

result_actions_ordered.when: no headers or no useful deltas arrive before timeout
result_actions_ordered.next: Transport/service/generation cause remains unresolved. Do not spend another flight to diagnose this model path.
Report all three outcomes and validation findings; use offline interface review. Three samples do not establish a success rate or justify adaptive selection of a favorable setting.

future_flight_budget.rule: Prediction + model + guard + IPC must fit within 598 seconds with a separately justified application margin. A 300-second offline observation limit is not authorization for a 300-second in-flight decision. Cold forecasts at their registered worst case already exceed the reservation with the existing model and guard budgets.

external_payload_scope: The already reconstructed synthetic flight observations, numerical estimates/bands, candidate previews, action effects and evidence IDs. No source, fault truth label, private task database, personal data or secret values are added. Authorization header exists only in host memory.
authorization: Preparation, contract tests and loopback HTTP/SSE smoke are allowed now. Three hosted diagnostic requests require the user's fresh explicit approval of the prepared plan hash. Earlier approval of the three-flight cohort does not authorize these requests.
end_preservation: Retain the original failed cohort, reconstructed original input, both request hashes, frozen registration/source, fixed per-replicate receipts and all missing/invalid outcomes. Keep raw prompt copies local and private; publish scalar metadata only. No deletion, no flight retry, no fourth diagnostic request.
